title: Trump's Playbook: 1 to Buy and 1 to Dump
creator: MarketBeat
source_note: Detailed summary generated from video captions
summary: "Trump's Playbook: 1 to Buy and 1 to Dump," published 2026-10-01 on MarketBeat, features Prof. Joel Litman of Altimetry Research on the regulation-vs-deregulation theme: banks benefit from Bowman-led Fed deregulation, while government equity stakes ensure survival, not profits. Two calls: FCNCA — BUY (first call on record, no flip), First Citizens as a nimble deregulation winner — 20 acquisitions including the SVB clean-up, commercial-and-industrial loan growth, uniform ROE above GAAP; the guest's guide is under $2,150–$2,200. MP — AVOID (first call on record, no flip), MP Materials: lost money in 2024–2026, down roughly 50% since the US government investment, needs unattainable margins and market share — the guest would not buy, would sell if held, and says it could fall another 50%. No stance flips this run.
